facts.fact: 拳击场休息时 Rory 问被众人排斥是否令他难受，Darragh 先用冷漠掩饰、被追问后承认「谁都会介意」，并透露自己 13 岁起就住在这里、还常被派去押人接受 atonement。
facts.anchor: “I haven’t known anything else. It doesn’t help that I am often the one who is sent to bring people in for atonements.” He shrugged, but I could see through the wall of indifference he was hiding behind.

facts.fact: Rory 冒失问 Ros 是不是他的情人，Darragh 大笑否认：10 年前他在酒馆外从一名体型两倍于她的 seraph 拳下救了 Ros，从此被她「欺负」成朋友；Ros 的 enchant 能又快又深地切开坚硬表面，做裁缝活好用、也容易惹祸。
facts.anchor: I met Ros ten years ago when I had to pull some asshole off her as he was punching her in the face outside a tavern.

facts.fact: Darragh 提示出拳时想象惹自己生气的人，Rory 脑中浮现 Terren 傲慢的脸、一拳砸响沙袋；Darragh 赞这一拳至少能打断鼻梁，Rory 得意不已。
facts.anchor: Terren’s arrogant prick of a face started to appear at the top. My eyes turned cold, and I flared my nostrils. Shoulder. Step. Rotate. Punch. THUD. The blow landed hard.

facts.fact: 用沙袋练了一小时「挣脱压制」后，Rory 坚持要真人演练；Darragh 因袭击就发生在昨天而犹豫，最终答应——条件是只要她脸上闪过一丝恐惧就立刻停止当天的训练。
facts.anchor: Darragh opened his mouth but then closed it, a moment passing before shaking his head. “Rory, your attack just happened yesterday.”

facts.fact: 压制演练变成暧昧：Darragh 跨骑压住 Rory、双手颤抖地握住她的手腕，拇指抚过她的嘴唇、低头贴近；Rory 把手放在他心口、点头闭眼默许。
facts.anchor: His weight pinned me down, and the muscles of his thighs tightened around me. His hands trembled as he grasped each of my wrists with large, calloused palms, sinking his chest and face toward mine.

facts.fact: 演练中房门被撞开、烈火扑面而来，Darragh 全身护住 Rory 并低声说「I’ve got you」；一层虹光穹顶把火挡在两人身外几寸处，随后火消散成浓烟。
facts.anchor: Darragh dropped his body fully on mine, arms wrapped around me tightly. I buried my face into his neck. “I’ve got you,” he muttered against my temple.

facts.fact: Gabriel 踹门闯入：一脚踢中 Darragh 肋骨把他掀开，再把 Rory 拽进怀里、拔出剑扬言「终于有理由除掉这个 abomination」；Rory 冲到两人中间张开双臂喝止，说明自己是自愿请 Darragh 训练、并未受伤。
facts.anchor: “Shh, shh. It’s alright, Rory. It’s alright. You’re safe now.” Gabriel pulled my head into his chest and turned me around, distancing me from Darragh. “Stay right here, and close your eyes,” he growled, pulling his sword from its sheath. “I finally have a reason to dispose of this abomination.”

facts.fact: 为安抚 Gabriel，Rory 编造袭击版本：逛店时溜出去看摊、在巷子里被一名想抢劫的 seraph 按倒在地、Darragh 转角相救；并称自己求 Darragh 教拳是为了「在 Gabriel 不在时」自保；Gabriel 信后把她搂进怀里，她因这侵入性的拥抱而僵住。
facts.anchor: Some seraph tried to rob me in an alley. I was such a stupid woman and didn’t listen when Darragh told me to keep to the shop we were in. A vendor outside interested me, and I slipped past Darragh to go look, only for a moment.

facts.fact: Darragh 愤然离场令 Rory 心沉；Gabriel 搭着她的后腰引她离开、说想念她和想多了解彼此，但 Rory 心里只剩对 Gabriel 刚才所作所为的愤怒，盘算日后伺机给他一番口头教训、同时还得把贵族面具重新贴好。
facts.anchor: Darragh stormed out of the sparring room, and as he left, my heart sank.
